# Copilot repository instructions — SELENE Moon Simulator

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before editing; it is the authoritative shared
instruction source. Follow its project-specific run/test commands and preservation
rules. Read PROJECT.md, TASKS.md, DECISIONS.md and docs/AGENT-WORKFLOW.md in the
repository root. Check the branch, dirty files and open PRs before starting;
use a dedicated branch, preserve other agents' work and keep secrets server-side.
Run relevant checks, record failures/limitations, commit and push work, and open
a review PR. Never merge or deploy production automatically. These instructions
add no independent architecture or feature requirements.
